headline: Apple's new foldable iPhone Duo sees delivery delays within hours of preorder
summary: Apple's $2,000 iPhone Duo, its first folding iPhone, opened for preorder at 8AM ET, and delivery estimates slipped into next year within about an hour as demand surged. Outlets report ship dates pushed to late January 2027, which one outlet calls a new wait-time record for Apple. Apple described the early demand as extraordinary. The foldable is slated to reach stores on October 23rd.
